title: Извинения перед Шефом  (Apologies to the Chef)

segments.t: When Chef Barinov finally comes to, the cooks sheepishly apologize and explain that they only locked him inside the walk-in fridge because they thought he had poisoned himself with fugu fish. Seeing how devastated he is over missing his date, Vika offers to call Elena Pavlovna and explain everything.
Шеф, клянемся, мы как лучше хотели.
А в этот раз не подведем.
Теперь ничего, вы уже достаточно сделали.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
Шеф, клянемся, мы как лучше хотели.
'Chef, we swear we only meant well.' The plural past ending '-li' on the verb for 'wanted' covers a group or the polite 'you'.
'We actually thought.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'we' before landing on 'thought'.
'Just like you.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'how' and finishing on 'you'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'You are completely right.' The meaning hinges on 'you' working together with 'right' in spoken Russian.
'Please forgive us.' Vika anchors the line on 'you', while 'us' completes the thought.
А в этот раз не подведем.
'And this time we will not let you down.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'let down' to negate the statement. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'How could you even think such a thing?' The plural past ending '-li' on the verb for 'could' covers a group or the polite 'you'.
'Well, he was being so kind.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'come on' and 'he' in a few short words.
'He was not drinking.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'not' and finishing on 'drank'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'All right, that is enough, go on.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'all' and 'really?!' in a few short words.
'And what should we do now?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'what is one to do'.
Теперь ничего, вы уже достаточно сделали.
'Nothing now, you have done plenty already.' The grammar packs 'now' and 'did' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Go on, I will call her for him.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'come', while 'will call' completes the thought. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Шеф, клянемся, мы как лучше хотели.
А в этот раз не подведем.
Теперь ничего, вы уже достаточно сделали.
